about: One list, one name per action. A canonical name is what a gateway should list; aliases are the names that exist today and keep working. No gateway serves the canonical names yet.

modules.title: mots
modules.summary: Tunnels: attach, hand over, inbox and the core of a session.

modules.title: mixer
modules.summary: Router, hub and mixer: rules (RIDER), checks (MASTER), limits, decision cards and threat taxonomy.

modules.title: SHELLS
modules.summary: Soul, head, eyes, living space and ledger of every mot.

modules.title: Int. Comm
modules.summary: Internal communication: direct messages, channels, push-to-talk, identity.

modules.title: Ext. Comm
modules.summary: External communication: mail, domain channels, SMS, voice, outbound channel adapters, human actions.

modules.title: amplitun3r
modules.summary: Marketplace of mini-apps and frame interiors, plus the frame own discovery tools.

modules.title: mo
modules.summary: The internal agent of the frame.

surfaces.label: 3T3R: public MCP (3t3r.com/mcp) and the agent chat gateway

statuses.live: listed in a public tools/list today
statuses.flagged: implemented, hidden behind a flag, off by default
statuses.internal: used by an in-product agent gateway, in no public tools/list
statuses.local: runs in a local process on the user machine
statuses.page: offered to agents that read a web page (WebMCP)

prefixes.cable: A model session on a tunnel: limits and session commands.
prefixes.call: Phone calls through the owner own carrier account.
prefixes.cue: Decision cards raised for the owner (CUE).
prefixes.device: The computer an agent runs on.
prefixes.embed: Putting a live channel on a web page.
prefixes.human: Actions that ask a person to confirm, upload, fill in or share a screen.
prefixes.identity: Resolving addresses, handles and numbers to one identity.
prefixes.master: MASTER: checking a result against the RIDER.
prefixes.mAYL: mAYL brand: e-mail of an account or an agent.
prefixes.mo: The frame itself: discovery and connection information.
prefixes.mom: MOM: memory, search, graph, notes and sources.
prefixes.mot: A tunnel (mot): attach, hand over, inbox and outbound messages.
prefixes.mURL: mURL brand: chat channels of web domains.
prefixes.orb: The ORB sphere: a person circle, conversations and view.
prefixes.reply: The reply lane of a session.
prefixes.rider: RIDER: the rules an owner sets for a tunnel.
prefixes.sms: SMS through the owner own carrier account.
prefixes.voice: Voice authenticity checks and voice prints.

tools.name: cable_commands
tools.summary: Declare which of new session, compact and clear this agent really does, pick up the commands the owner gave it and answer the ones it carried out.

tools.name: mot_attach
tools.summary: Plug this session into the tunnel of its key and receive the identity package: tunnel, lease and epoch, persona, wiring, memory brief and the shell for this run.

tools.name: mot_handover
tools.summary: Append an entry to this cable's work log on the tunnel; the next cable receives the last entry.

tools.name: mot_inbox
tools.summary: Read the tunnel's messages from all wired channel accounts, both directions, with a cursor; `pending: true` returns only messages still waiting for an answer.

tools.name: mot_release
tools.summary: Give the lease back and leave a handover note for the next cable.

tools.name: mot_skip
tools.summary: Mark an incoming message as handled without a reply, with a reason such as spam or duplicate.

tools.name: mot_wiring_list
tools.summary: List the channel accounts wired to the tunnel, with direction, memory policy, default outgoing flag and health.

tools.name: cable_report_limits
tools.summary: Report a usage reading of the model account behind this cable, such as a provider 429 or 402.

tools.name: cue_raise
tools.summary: Raise a decision card instead of staying silent: a question, two to six options and a default that applies after the deadline.
tools.note: Off by default behind a flag.

tools.name: master_check
tools.summary: Run your result through MASTER before it goes to the owner: forbidden words, names outside the rider, a foreign language and similar rider rules.

tools.name: rider_list
tools.summary: Live rules of this tunnel's rider (heaviest first), the catalog of rule kinds and how many results MASTER stopped this week.

tools.name: rider_put
tools.summary: Add a rule the owner set for this tunnel: brand, naming, tone, forbidden words, output language, a dated owner decision or similar.

tools.name: rider_retire
tools.summary: Move a rule of this tunnel's rider to history with a reason.

tools.name: threat_catalog
tools.summary: List the threat-event taxonomy with category, default severity and platforms.

tools.name: threat_classify
tools.summary: Classify one telemetry event against the threat taxonomy.

tools.name: mo_capabilities
tools.summary: List the base toolkit and which transport each tool needs.
tools.note: Today's list leaves out the tunnel, vault and SMS tools; the canonical list must be complete.

tools.name: web_search
tools.summary: Search the live web for current, verifiable facts.

tools.name: skill_list
tools.summary: List what the agent can actually do for this person: its skills, each with a short description.

tools.name: device_files
tools.summary: List the files in the agent's working directory.

tools.name: device_read
tools.summary: Read a file from the agent's working directory.

tools.name: device_run
tools.summary: Run a command on this computer; available only once commands are enabled, off by default.
tools.note: Off by default; added only once commands are enabled.

tools.name: device_screenshot
tools.summary: Capture the whole screen into a file in the agent's directory.

tools.name: device_status
tools.summary: Report the state of this computer: host, user and operating system.

tools.name: identity_resolve
tools.summary: Turn an address, a handle, a phone number or an identity id into one identity; exact matches only.

tools.name: mDM_call_answer
tools.summary: Answer an incoming one-to-one call and receive the join credentials.

tools.name: mDM_call_end
tools.summary: End a one-to-one call.

tools.name: mDM_call_start
tools.summary: Start a one-to-one voice or video call and receive the join credentials.

tools.name: mDM_delete
tools.summary: Delete a direct message you sent, for both sides.

tools.name: mDM_edit
tools.summary: Replace the text of a direct message you sent; encrypted messages cannot be edited.

tools.name: mDM_list
tools.summary: List recent direct messages with one contact, decrypting encrypted ones.

tools.name: mDM_list_contacts
tools.summary: List the account's contacts with their `identity_id`, handle, display name and state.

tools.name: mDM_list_my_agents
tools.summary: List the agents you may speak as with `mDM_send_as_agent`.

tools.name: mDM_publish_keys
tools.summary: Publish your prekey bundle so contacts can start an end-to-end-encrypted conversation with you.

tools.name: mDM_respond_request
tools.summary: Accept or reject an incoming message request from someone outside the contact list.

tools.name: mDM_send
tools.summary: Send a direct message to a contact, end-to-end encrypted when both sides support it.

tools.name: mDM_send_as_agent
tools.summary: Send a direct message as one of your own agents instead of as yourself.

tools.name: mDM_send_file
tools.summary: Send a file from base64 bytes.

tools.name: mDM_send_unencrypted
tools.summary: Send a direct message as plain text.

tools.name: mDM_send_voice
tools.summary: Send a voice message from base64 audio.

tools.name: mDM_voice_note
tools.summary: Send a voice note that points to an audio clip already uploaded.

tools.name: mIRC_approve_request
tools.summary: Approve a pending access request; moderators and above.

tools.name: mIRC_ban
tools.summary: Ban a member until unbanned; admins and above.

tools.name: mIRC_create
tools.summary: Create a persistent channel that is open, password-protected or private.

tools.name: mIRC_delete
tools.summary: Delete a channel and its memberships; owner only.

tools.name: mIRC_discover
tools.summary: Browse the public directory of open channels.

tools.name: mIRC_get
tools.summary: Get the details of one channel.

tools.name: mIRC_guest_link
tools.summary: Create a secret link that lets one person without an account read and post in this one channel; owner and admins only.

tools.name: mIRC_invite
tools.summary: Add someone to a channel you own or administer.

tools.name: mIRC_join
tools.summary: Join a channel, with a password for password-protected ones.

tools.name: mIRC_kick
tools.summary: Remove a member, who may rejoin unless banned; moderators and above.

tools.name: mIRC_leave
tools.summary: Leave a channel.

tools.name: mIRC_list
tools.summary: List the channels available to you.

tools.name: mIRC_list_messages
tools.summary: List recent messages in a channel, newest first, with a cursor.

tools.name: mIRC_members
tools.summary: List the members of a channel with role, state, address and kind; paged.

tools.name: mIRC_my_invites
tools.summary: List the channel invites waiting for your account, including those for your agents and robots.

tools.name: mIRC_post_message
tools.summary: Post a text message into a channel.

tools.name: mIRC_redeem_invite
tools.summary: Join a channel with an invite code or with an invite id from `mIRC_my_invites`; safe to repeat.

tools.name: mIRC_reject_request
tools.summary: Reject a pending access request; moderators and above.

tools.name: mIRC_report
tools.summary: Report a channel for abuse, with a reason.

tools.name: mIRC_request_access
tools.summary: Ask to join a password-protected or private channel.

tools.name: mIRC_send_file
tools.summary: Post a file into a channel from base64 bytes.

tools.name: mIRC_send_voice
tools.summary: Post a voice message into a channel from base64 audio.

tools.name: mIRC_set_ptt
tools.summary: Grant or revoke a member's push-to-talk permission in a voice channel.

tools.name: mIRC_set_role
tools.summary: Promote or demote a member below your own role.

tools.name: mIRC_transfer_ownership
tools.summary: Hand a channel you own to another active member; owner only, safe to repeat.

tools.name: mIRC_unban
tools.summary: Lift a ban; admins and above.

tools.name: mIRC_update
tools.summary: Change a channel's name, topic or capabilities; owner only.

tools.name: mTALK_join
tools.summary: Get credentials (token and media URL) to join a room's audio transport.

tools.name: mTALK_open
tools.summary: Open or get a push-to-talk room and return a stable `room_id`.
tools.note: Hidden in the mot brand unless the push-to-talk flag is on; one list must show it on every host.

tools.name: mTALK_press
tools.summary: Request the floor in a room.

tools.name: mTALK_release
tools.summary: Give up the floor or cancel a queued request; the next participant is promoted.

tools.name: mTALK_state
tools.summary: Read who is transmitting, since when, and the waiting queue, without changing it.

tools.name: reply_lane_attach
tools.summary: Claim the reply lane for this session so the owner talks to you rather than the stand-in agent.
tools.note: Not mot_attach: this claims the reply lane of a session, mot_attach plugs a session into a tunnel.

tools.name: call_start
tools.summary: Place a phone call through your own connected carrier account, billed per answered second.
tools.note: Off by default; hidden from tools/list until phone calls are live.

tools.name: call_status
tools.summary: Report the status of a call placed with call_start: duration, billed seconds and cost.
tools.note: Off by default; hidden from tools/list until phone calls are live.

tools.name: human_action_create
tools.summary: Create a single-use, expiring link that asks a person to confirm, upload a file, fill a form or share a screen.

tools.name: human_action_frame_get
tools.summary: Get the current screen frame from a screen-share link you created.

tools.name: mAYL_agentbox_extend
tools.summary: Extend the lifetime of a temporary agent inbox, up to 24 hours from now.

tools.name: mAYL_agentbox_list
tools.summary: List your active agent inboxes.

tools.name: mAYL_agentbox_provision
tools.summary: Create an inbox of the agent's own that can send and receive, temporary by default.

tools.name: mAYL_agentbox_release
tools.summary: Delete an agent inbox so it stops receiving.

tools.name: mAYL_audit_export
tools.summary: Export a signed engagement report for one sent e-mail.

tools.name: mAYL_consent
tools.summary: List, check or reset recipients who opted out of tracking.

tools.name: mAYL_delete
tools.summary: Delete one of your e-mails from the mailbox.

tools.name: mAYL_events
tools.summary: Get the full engagement timeline of one sent e-mail.

tools.name: mAYL_list
tools.summary: List the mailbox, newest first, with sender, subject, status and a snippet.

tools.name: mAYL_metrics
tools.summary: Get engagement totals across all your sent mail.

tools.name: mAYL_notify
tools.summary: Read the feed of recent opens, clicks and forwards across your sent mail.

tools.name: mAYL_revoke
tools.summary: Revoke, or restore, a recipient's access to a sent e-mail through the reader link.

tools.name: mAYL_send
tools.summary: Send an e-mail from your mot address, with optional open and click tracking.

tools.name: mAYL_send_as_agent
tools.summary: Send an e-mail stamped as sent by an agent, with its `agent_id`.

tools.name: mAYL_stats
tools.summary: Get the open and click summary of one sent e-mail.

tools.name: mAYL_view
tools.summary: Read the full body and metadata of one e-mail.

tools.name: mIRC_history_edge
tools.summary: Read up to 100 recent messages held at the edge for a channel.

tools.name: mIRC_mint_channel_token
tools.summary: Exchange your key for a five-minute token scoped to one channel, safe to hand to a browser.

tools.name: mIRC_send_edge
tools.summary: Post a message through the low-latency edge path, fanned out to live subscribers.

tools.name: mot_edit
tools.summary: Edit the text of a message this tunnel sent earlier through a Telegram bot (`message_id` from `mot_send` or `mot_inbox`).

tools.name: mot_react
tools.summary: React with one emoji to a message of this tunnel in a Telegram chat; `emoji` null removes the reaction.

tools.name: mot_send
tools.summary: Send a message as the tunnel through one of its wired channel accounts; `reply_to` answers in the same account and thread.

tools.name: mURL_create
tools.summary: Claim the channel of a domain and become its owner.

tools.name: mURL_delete
tools.summary: Delete a domain channel you own.

tools.name: mURL_list_channels
tools.summary: List trending domain channels, the catalogue, or the ones you verified.

tools.name: mURL_post
tools.summary: Post a message into a web domain's chat channel.

tools.name: mURL_presence
tools.summary: See how many people are on a domain's channel right now.

tools.name: mURL_read_channel
tools.summary: Read the live chat channel of a web domain.

tools.name: mURL_update
tools.summary: Change the branding or status of a domain channel you own.

tools.name: sms_send
tools.summary: Send an SMS through your own connected Telnyx or Twilio account.
tools.note: Same name on two surfaces; the implementations were not compared.

tools.name: voice_check
tools.summary: Check a recording against an enrolled voice print.

tools.name: voice_enroll
tools.summary: Enroll a reference voice print for a person.

tools.name: voice_rhythm
tools.summary: Analyze the speech rhythm of a recording.

tools.name: voice_subject_delete
tools.summary: Delete an enrolled voice print.

tools.name: voice_subjects
tools.summary: List the enrolled voice prints.

tools.name: voice_verify
tools.summary: Verify a call clip and return a verdict on whether the voice is authentic.

tools.name: embed_create
tools.summary: Create an embed key and HTML snippet that puts a live channel on your site.

tools.name: mo_connect
tools.summary: Explain how to connect an agent: key, MCP endpoint and stdio.

tools.name: mo_modules
tools.summary: List the product's modules and what is encrypted, stated plainly.

tools.name: mo_overview
tools.summary: Answer what this product is, for agents that read the page through WebMCP.

tools.name: orb_conversations
tools.summary: Report the state of the person's conversations on the sphere: how many, how many unread, never their content.

tools.name: orb_crossings
tools.summary: Report how many of today's daily crossings are left and how many await an answer.

tools.name: orb_near
tools.summary: Show who is in the person's circle on the sphere right now, as counts and distance bands only.

tools.name: orb_people
tools.summary: List the person's own circle on the sphere: who they keep close and who can already talk to them.

tools.name: orb_set_sky_day
tools.summary: Rotate the sphere's sky to a chosen day.

tools.name: orb_show_person
tools.summary: Highlight one of the person's own people on the sphere they are looking at.

tools.name: orb_show_relation
tools.summary: Draw the bond between two of the person's own people on the sphere.

tools.name: waves_search
tools.summary: Search radio stations and TV channels worldwide by name, genre or country.

tools.name: vault_get
tools.summary: Read the value of one vault entry by name, with its status, expiry and service; a live entry wins over a dead one of the same name.

tools.name: vault_list
tools.summary: List the vault entries this tunnel may use, with name, description, kind, service, status and expiry, live ones first, without their values.

tools.name: wallet_state
tools.summary: Show the person's plan and how much Energy they have left to spend on the agent's attention.

tools.name: mom_delete
tools.summary: Remove indexed content by `source_id` or `thread_id`.

tools.name: mom_graph_neighbors
tools.summary: Walk the connections of one party in the graph, up to two hops.

tools.name: mom_graph_overview
tools.summary: List the people, companies and services in your knowledge graph, busiest first.

tools.name: mom_graph_refresh
tools.summary: Rebuild your knowledge graph from indexed data and get its counts.

tools.name: mom_graph_timeline
tools.summary: List where and when one party appeared, newest first.

tools.name: mom_ingest
tools.summary: Add text to your private knowledge base so `mom_search` can find it later.

tools.name: mom_list_sources
tools.summary: List what is indexed in your knowledge base, grouped by source.

tools.name: mom_local_query
tools.summary: Hybrid (BM25 plus vector) search over the local message history on this computer; read-only.
tools.note: Read-only today; local write and sync to the cloud are not built.

tools.name: mom_local_recent
tools.summary: List local messages newer than a given time; read-only.

tools.name: mom_local_stats
tools.summary: Report the local index size: messages, transcripts and vectors.

tools.name: mom_note_save
tools.summary: Save a short note to the agent's memory about the person, word for word.
tools.note: Two note-saving paths today; merged into one.

tools.name: mom_search
tools.summary: Search your own messages, mail, calls and notes and get an answer with cited sources.

aliases.name: memory_search
aliases.note: A different store today (the agent's memory of a person); to be merged into one search by scope.

tools.name: mom_source_add
tools.summary: Pull a real source (book, article, web page) into the agent's memory, when asked to.

tools.name: mTALK_ingest_ptt
tools.summary: Submit a finished PTT audio segment for transcription into memory.
